text:
Priya: heads up — linkcheck failing on deploy preview for /reference/sdk/auth.md, fragment `#create-session` not found even though the heading exists in source.
BuildBot: linkcheck: page=reference/sdk/auth.md fragment=create-session status=404 run=CI#9155
Jorge: can you paste the exact heading line? my bet is emoji or inline code in the H2
Priya: sure:
```
## Creating a session with `Client.createSession()` 🚀
```
Marta: yep emoji + inline code. Different slugifiers handle emoji differently; sometimes the rocket gets included in the slug, sometimes removed -> mismatch.
Jorge: two low friction options: 1) add explicit id: `## Creating a session with Client.createSession() {#create-session}` or 2) make the anchor-target linkpoint to the generated slug (but that's brittle if renderer changes)
Priya: let's do explicit id for stability. I'll open a small PR to add the anchor and update the example cross-link in /guides/session.md which points to `#create-session`.
DocsOps: also consider adding a docs linter rule: flag headings that contain emoji or inline code and suggest an explicit id. Saves future CI flakes.
BuildBot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/4211 by @priya — CI queued
Jorge: small nit — prefer to remove backticks around the method name in the heading to keep it plain text, and keep inline code in the doc body. But explicit id is fine.
Marta: I'll prep a follow-up PR to propose a CONTRIBUTING.md entry: "Prefer explicit header ids for headings containing code or emoji" and add a tiny example.
Priya: PR #4211 updated — added `{#create-session}` and fixed the crosslink in guides. Running linkcheck again locally passes.
BuildBot: CI passed for PR #4211 — all checks green.
Jorge: LGTM. One reviewer: @marta? (assigning)
Marta: approved and merged. I've added the checklist item to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md in a separate commit.
DocsOps: filing a ticket to evaluate switching mkdocs slugify to python-slugify in staging to reduce surprises (DOCS-332).
Priya: thanks folks — closing thread. If anyone spots other failing fragments, drop them here and we'll triage.
